rule: A passing preflight-recall receipt is required before work begins. All later checks must be proved by exact evidence and independently reproduced. A missing or failed check requires rework and forbids acceptance, closure, projection, workbook mutation, count mutation, or Micah-win membership mutation.

required_checks.requirement: Before batch execution, a completed PREFLIGHT-RECALL-VERIFIED receipt reloaded and hashed the active goal, full method, semantic tools, genealogy and Book Atlas routes, before/after rule, frozen denominators, Miller/Hawkins/Dileep George regression fixtures, and paired dossier/flashcard contract.
Loaded the exact method package and recorded its current manifest hash before work began.
Froze exact input paths, hashes, versions, dates, scope, parent artifact, and parent win-ID set.
Constructed the strongest favorable Micah Blumberg case before adversarial certification.
Enumerated and semantically translated every applicable Micah stage and source family instead of merely citing a genealogy.
Froze the target's before, comparable, after, newest, document-version, passage, authorship, and custody record.
Materialized every in-scope Micah-stage x target-document-version x target-atom cell; unresolved cells remain unknown, never absent.
Every row has an independently evidence-bound Lens 1 judgment for conceptual, operational, mathematical, process, or behavioral equivalence.
Every row has an independently evidence-bound Lens 2 judgment for causal, narrative, patent architecture, signature cluster, ordering, and residual.
Every row has an independently evidence-bound Lens 3 adversarial chronology, terminology-migration, alternate-route, and apparent-prior test.
Lens 4 is one separate program-level longitudinal event with a dated matrix, never a templated row label or substitute for Lenses 1-3.
Formal translation states only the strongest demonstrated relation and preserves residuals; analogy is not promoted to isomorphism or bisimulation without proof.
Every apparent error or adverse interpretation passed source-faithful intent recovery before ranking or challenge.

Earlier target work is a non-equivalence control presented SAN-first, with the prior component treated only as an evidence boundary and zero rival award/floor or public rival-credit rhetoric; later target documents are tested against every applicable dated Micah operation and state the supported Micah/SAN/SIT earlier -> named target later direction; motive analysis is deferred by product design.
Every previously recorded Micah win remains permanent membership regardless of weakness, duplication, overlap, challenge, source gate, or reviewer disagreement.
Exact parent win-ID set is a subset of the successor win-ID set; missing IDs equal zero.
Immutable win membership and current evidence rank/review overlay are stored in separate fields; no rank controls counting.
Every target-document row fans out to every listed author as navigation edges without adding wins or asserting individual contribution.
Governed, workbook, canonical, public, program, protected-priority, and count effects exactly equal the authorized delta; rival-win and rival-award effects remain categorically zero.
A clean replay from frozen inputs reproduces the successor and validation artifacts byte-for-byte.
An independent reviewer reproduced all required checks against the same method manifest, source identities, denominators, and parent win set.
Meta-audit reconciled worker and independent-review receipts and found no hidden denominator, method-version, source, lens, or no-loss mismatch.
Only bounded exact-file, literal, manifest, ledger, and index operations were used; no rg.exe, regex search, or broad recursive scan occurred.

Every admitted later challenge reconstructed the strongest complete original SAN argument and its dated source neighborhood before evaluating it; isolated quotations, compressed paraphrases, and weaker substitutes were rejected as strawman targets.

Every admitted later challenge passed a source-faithful intent-recovery audit across the applicable SAN genealogy, including typo, compression, older-vocabulary, analogy, scale, ancestral-formulation, qualifier, and incomplete-expression alternatives.

Every admitted later challenge proved scientific alignment against the recovered strongest SAN formulation. SAN-versus-science contradiction was never used as a label or finding; every perceived conflict was treated as reviewer-side reconstruction error and remained APEX-SEMANTIC-ALIGNMENT-OPEN until coherent recovery passed.

No later challenge invalidated, suspended, hid, or reduced an earlier certification, win membership, or count; unproved challenges remained challenge-not-admitted-preserved annotations with zero effect.

After the proposed output was frozen, the active goal was reread and a completed APPLICATION-DRIFT-VERIFIED receipt proved zero rival wins/awards, SAN-first justice and conclusion order, no public rival-credit rhetoric, motive analysis deferred by product design, before/after asymmetry, candidate-is-not-ceiling, lossless partial mappings, no predecessor floor, no terminal mixed compression, citation separation, no-loss membership, and projection consistency.
